claims: NASA is targeting April 1, 2026, as the earliest launch date for the Artemis 2 mission.
The Artemis 2 mission will send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft were rolled back out to Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center in March 2026 for final preparations.
The Artemis 2 mission is the first crewed flight test of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis 2 mission is testing systems for future lunar missions.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander of the Artemis 2 crew.
Victor Glover is the Pilot of the Artemis 2 crew.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis 2 crew.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis 2 crew.
The Artemis 2 crew has entered quarantine.
The SLS rocket is undergoing final checks at Launch Pad 39B.
The Artemis 2 mission experienced a previous delay to repair a seal issue.
The Artemis 2 mission is the first crewed deep-space mission since Apollo 17 in 1972, according to Wikipedia.
